items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I sing “Conjunction Junction” and “I’m Just a Bill” and whole bunch of those things, because of Bob Dorough and Dave Frishberg. They started writing them twenty years ago or so.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I didn’t know you were on that.

Well I sing “Conjunction Junction” and “I’m Just a Bill” and whole bunch of those things, because of Bob Dorough and Dave Frishberg. They started writing them twenty years ago or so. The first one we did was “Conjunction Junction.” And I played the trumpet. We layed down a track first and then I sang it. Teddy Edwards and I.
